description: Source code for device management in Zephyr RTOS, including device initialization, binding, readiness checks, and dependency handling.

methods.name: z_device_state_init
methods.description: Initializes the state for all static devices by iterating over device sections and initializing each device object.

methods.name: z_impl_device_get_binding
methods.description: Retrieves a device binding by name, first attempting pointer comparison, then string comparison.

methods.name: z_vrfy_device_get_binding
methods.description: Verification wrapper for device get binding in user space, copying the name string safely.

methods.name: z_vrfy_device_is_ready
methods.description: Verification wrapper to check if a device is ready, with syscall object initialization check.

methods.name: z_device_get_all_static
methods.description: Returns the total number of static devices and fills the provided array with device pointers.

methods.name: z_device_is_ready
methods.description: Checks if a device is initialized and has no init residual error.
